source.name: Footy Headlines: Newcastle Jets 26-27 AFC Champions League Elite Home & Away Kits Released
source.note: The ACL Elite home kit is a separate shirt from the club's 2026/27 A-League home jersey (which carries Oz Shipping Containers on the front, per the club's 2 Oct 2026 announcement). Wadam Living sits across the midriff, also visible in the club shop's product photos for the '2026/27 Newcastle Jets ACLE Home Jersey'.
source.quote: Both shirts feature the club crest, New Balance logos, and the Wadam Living sponsor across the midriff, as well as the official AFC Champions League Elite tournament sleeve patch on the right arm

source.name: Footy Headlines: Newcastle Jets 26-27 AFC Champions League Elite Home & Away Kits Released
source.note: Kit supplier; New Balance logo on the chest of the launch photos. Recorded for the placement the announcement gives it in the shirt lineup.
source.quote: Crafted by New Balance, the special collection takes direct inspiration from the kits worn during the club's very first Asian continental adventure back in 2009

summary: Newcastle Jets 2026/27 AFC Champions League Elite home kit (New Balance supplier), a 2009-throwback shirt separate from the club's 2026/27 A-League home jersey. Front: Wadam Living across the midriff. Both sleeves carry the AFC Champions League Elite patch (competition badge, not a sponsor; confirmed in the club shop product text and close-up photos). Back carries player name and number only (match photos from Kashima Antlers 7-1 Newcastle Jets, 15 Sep 2026); shorts carry the New Balance logo and club crest only. The club's 2026/27 A-League Men's home jersey instead has Oz Shipping Containers on the front (club announcement, 2 Oct 2026).
headline: The shirt is {level}: Wadam Living, a Newcastle property business, pays for the front of the ACL Elite shirt.
